RAMKENI SIANI BILSI RITCHASA ONG-ANIKO MAMIANINA GHAPA KA-ATGIPA: A+CHIK LITERATURE SOCIET, TUA 2013 --- Page 5 --- REV.
RAMKENI SIANI BILSI RITCHASA ONG·ANIKO MANIANINA SEANIRANG CHAPAKA·ATGIPA: A·CHIK LITERATURE SOCIETY, TURA 2013 --- Page 6 --- O A·CHIK LITERATURE SOCIETY FIRST EDITION: 2013 No.
ofCopies: 1,000 Dam: R 80/- Coverna Noksa Salgipa : Te Sembertush A.
Sangma Printed at: Panthi Offset Printers, Sukbir Bhawan, Tura --- Page 7 --- AGANCHENGANI A·chik Literature Societyko a.bachengao Garo Literature Society ine biming donachim.
Ja'mano Societyni Executive Committee tom'aniko dakate, chanchirime, "Garo" kattani pal "A·chik" kattako on'skana tik ka'aha.
Indake Societyko "A-chik Literature Society" ine mingskaaha.
A.chik Literature Society A-chikku Sea-Jotaniko nambatatna, bariatna, gadang tangdoatna aro am-kolamna jotton ka-enga.
A-chik Bananko tik ka-na gita, oikor mingantina Sub-Committeerangko done, kattarangni bananko tik ka'ani kamko a-bachengengaha.
Somoi ra-gen; indiba salsaode an.ching sakantian an·tangtangni namnika ba ongnika banankon jakkalaienga.
Bano ‘t' ba “k' ge-gni ong'gen, ‘raka' dongama dongja, namatna Society kam ka'enga.
MBOSE-ni A-chikkuo Class-Ioni XII-ona tarigipa ki-taprangko, subjectantinan che-eme niaha.
Classni kri text-ni melia meligijani, katta bichongrangko baseani, mingantikon, subjectna kragipa manderangko Sub- Committee done sandiaha.
Ia Sub-Committeerangni am'e mangiminrangko dondime, Report tarie, Reportko MBOSE-ni Executive Chairman-na on-aha.
Indiba da'alonaba uamangni aganchakaniko man·kuja.
Bilsiantian A.chik Literature Society General Conferenceko ong'atronga.

Ia Conferenceo A-chik Literature Societyni Niam Amako ba Constitutionko namdapatna nangnikode namdapata, chanchirimanirangko daka aro Seminar ong-ate, Lekkarangko sebaate, uarangnibidingo chanchianirangkodaka.
A.chik Literature Society jagittamprako “A-chik Ku'rang" magazineko chapa ka-ata.

Man-adipet, A-chik jatni songsar, jatni dakbewal- rikbewalrang, niam-bewalrang, niam-retirang, A.chik Ku-sik, magitcham --- Page 8 --- pagitchamrangonin ku'ritingbaenggipa golporang aro uarang gitako magazineo gata.
la kamrangko daka-ka'aniara Society-o tangka-paisa donggijanichi peng:pangatako mana.
Indaken Seminar Paperrangko kitapni bimango nakatatna skoba, sengkuna ga-akaia.
1991 bilsio, "A Tribute To A Tribal Genius" ine katta bichong done, Rev.
Ramke Wa-tre Mominni Siani bilsi ritchasa onganiko manina Seminar ong'ataha.
Seminarna Seanirangko Rev.

Ramkeni Janggi Tangani, Mondoliko Rikanio aro Silroro- Namroroatanio Bak Ra-ani, Salgro-Salaramni Baptist Mondolirangni Itihaso Mongsonggipa Bakko Ra-ani, Mandeni Bewal aro Toromni Dilgipa Ong'ani, Uni A-chikku Sea-Jotanina On'gilani, Lekka-Porana Ongilani aro Nokdang Ba-ku Dakanio On:paani-rango pangchakata.
Caroline R.
Marakni segimin "Rev.
Ramkeni Janggi Tangani"-de changgipin Seminarna segipasa.
Katta bichong apsanani gimin uko iano man-chapatenga.
Ia Seminar Paperrangko ki-tapni bimango nakatatna 2011 bilsio tik ka-aha.
Korosni bidingan ia ru-utani ja'pang asel.
Gipin Seminar Paperrangkoba ka-sin ka-sin chapa ka-attokna chanchienga.
A-chik Literature Societyni Executive Committee ia Seminar Indake chinga pilak seanirangko nipiltaie, “"Rev.
Ramkeni Siani Bilsi Ritchasa Ong-aniko Manianina Seanirang" ine Katta Bichong on'e, uko ki-tapni bimango nakatatna kusi ong'a.
Llewellyn Rangsa Marak Ma.
Brucellish Koksi Sangma Ma.
Brucelline Garrey Momin.
